Build a ROCm-6.2 sustained-link probe that records the complete MI210 rate trace and effective threshold rather than copying CUDA sleep and bandwidth constants.
Implement fixed routing-order FP32 slot/gather with one parsed deterministic configuration, explicit top-k bounds, streamed-tier coverage and TP/CPU expert-slice sentinels.
Measure folded and unfolded reconstruction against the same unquantized teacher and report scratch occupancy, bandwidth and repeat-run determinism on MI210.
Retain unified runtime-K and grouped K-specialized CPU/HIP paths and sweep device, model/pack and routed-row shape with raw launch, occupancy, HBM-byte and timing receipts.

Measure unified, grouped and leftover-expert fallback paths independently on MI210 and EPYC, including buckets below four experts, launch counts, rocprof traces, HBM traffic, output error and repeated timing distributions.
Keep routing-k order stable while filtering nonlocal sentinel slots and compare CPU/GPU partials only after each side masks out-of-domain assignments.
